cohort: 296 singleton pregnancies from egg donation (gestation > 24 weeks), who delivered January 2008-February 2019 at Sant'Anna Hospital, Turin, Italy, compared to 1407 low-risk singleton pregnancies from the TOrino Cagliari Observational Study (2009-2016).
finding: Patients with baseline renal disease or "other" comorbidity had a higher risk of developing PE or preterm delivery after ED.
